responsibility: Serves as the public entry point for MIR interpretation support in `rustc_middle`, re-exporting interpreter memory, pointer, scalar, and error APIs while defining shared interpreter-level identifiers and global allocation machinery such as `GlobalId`, `AllocId`, alloc-id encoding/decoding state, alloc interning, and target-endian integer byte I/O helpers.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `mir/mod.rs`, which defines MIR’s general IR structures and control-flow concepts, this `mod.rs` is specifically the interpretation/CTFE surface: it re-exports interpreter memory/value/error pieces and owns `GlobalId`/`AllocId` plus global allocation interning and encoding support.
